date.source: the broadcast's own four-part newsgroup serialization, all four parts posted 18 November 2001

appearances.note: Enters the Arezzo/Demolisher match but abandons it, chasing Timmy Princeton through the crowd before either man is pinned.
Attacks Legacy backstage before his own match; stripped of the World Heavyweight Championship by Sandra Lewis moments before the bell; attacked with a bat by Jack Diamond after the show.
Also confronts Slezy D backstage before his own match.
Attacked backstage by Brandon Thornton before the Andrews match, then loaded into an ambulance and beaten with a hockey stick; Carnage runs in for the save.
Fights Carnage backstage trying to reach Legacy, attacks Robby Smith, and interferes in the Andrews-Thornton match.
Interferes in the Andrews-Thornton match and attacks Thornton with a bat as he leaves the arena after the show.
Fights Johnny Rebel backstage, saves Legacy from a hockey-stick beating, and interferes to help SuperCat win the North American title.
Attacked backstage by Johnny Rebel and dragged off by Carnage.
Introduced as the XBWL's new owner and strips Brandon Thornton of the World Heavyweight Championship.
Introduces Sandra Lewis as the new owner and leaves.
Interferes for El Camero against Timmy Princeton and helps SuperCat win the North American title.
Accompanies Deadly Domination and is put through a table by SuperCat.

matches.note: Ends when Talon beats both opponents down with a chair; no pinfall is described.
Arezzo wins with "The Perfect Crime"; Slezy D leaves the match before it is decided, chasing Timmy Princeton through the crowd. Brandon Thornton attacks Arezzo with a chair afterward.

Billed for Thornton's XBWL World Heavyweight Championship, but new owner Sandra Lewis strips Thornton of the title moments before the bell, leaving it vacant and off the line. Jack Diamond and Johnny Rebel both interfere before Andrews wins with a roll-up.
Relocated to a specially built ring on the arena roof. Broken pins Shawn Ryder after both crash through a table together; Felony is not involved in the fall.
El Camero's partners SuperCat and El Dorito interfere repeatedly, including a low blow and a chair shot, before the pinfall.

matches.stipulation: Four Corners, Elimination, Flaming Tables Match

eliminations.note: Put through a table by El Camero and El Dorito, neither of whom is in the match.
Hip-tossed by SuperCat through a flaming table.
Pushed by SuperCat into a flaming table El Dorito had set for him.

matches.note: For the vacant XBWL North American Championship; the broadcast calls SuperCat "the first man to win a title in the new XBWL."
